summaries.en: DeepSeek-V4-Pro is an advanced open-source language model designed for high-quality text generation and conversational AI. It builds on the Mixture-of-Experts architecture, activating only relevant parameters per token for efficiency. With FP8 quantization support, it reduces memory usage without sacrificing performance. You can deploy it via Hugging Face's endpoints or run it locally with transformers. Ideal for chatbots, content creation, and code assistance, it offers a strong balance of capability and accessibility.
summaries.zh: DeepSeek-V4-Pro 是一个先进的开源语言模型，专为高质量文本生成和对话式 AI 设计。它基于混合专家架构，每次推理只激活部分参数，从而在保持性能的同时大幅提升效率。模型支持 FP8 量化，能显著降低显存占用，适合在消费级 GPU 上运行。你可以通过 Hugging Face 的推理端点直接使用，或利用 transformers 库本地部署。典型应用包括智能客服、内容创作和代码辅助。其 MIT 许可证允许自由商用和修改，是构建 AI 应用的实用选择。

summaries.en: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct is a compact vision-language model that brings multimodal AI to resource-constrained environments. It excels at understanding images, documents, and text simultaneously, making it ideal for chatbots and document analysis. Technically, it uses a hybrid architecture combining a vision encoder with a language model, supporting high-resolution images and multi-turn conversations. You can deploy it locally via Hugging Face Transformers, fine-tune it for specific tasks like OCR or visual QA, or integrate it into applications requiring real-time image understanding without cloud dependency.
summaries.zh: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct是一款轻量级视觉语言模型，专为资源受限场景设计，可同时理解图像、文档与文本，适用于聊天机器人和文档分析。其核心采用混合架构：视觉编码器处理高分辨率图像，语言模型支持多轮对话，实现图像与文本的深度交互。用户可通过Hugging Face Transformers本地部署，无需云端依赖，并可针对OCR、视觉问答等任务微调。该模型在保持高性能的同时大幅降低计算需求，是边缘设备实现多模态AI的理想选择。
